variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: One-base duplication predicted to cause a frameshift (p.(Ala270GlyfsTer4) on the batch transcript; the paper writes p.Ala270Glyfs*3).

concerns: Protein notation differs in the stop position: paper p.Ala270Glyfs*3 vs batch p.(Ala270GlyfsTer4), although the batch's protein_check says 'agrees'.

Possible mosaicism: the cited source (reference 16) is titled 'Detection of somatic and germline mosaicism for the LAMP2 gene mutation c.808dupG in a Chinese family with Danon disease'. Whether this asymptomatic woman is the mosaic individual is not stated.
Review-table entry only; no case description in 36876541. The primary report (Chen et al. 2012, Gene) is not in this batch, and the affected relatives implied by its title are not in the batch.
notes_for_panel: Only an XCI ratio and an asymptomatic status at 38 are available; the family data are in the cited source.
